root_cause: From 11 to 27 October ten personal LinkedIn posts have a provider-acknowledged URN in content_publication_obligations, but none exists in social_posts (last row 2026-10-09, 17 rows in tenant canonical). bg-social-metrics-sync only registered company proofs and Instagram media; linkedin() reads personal rows from social_posts, so it found nothing to measure and the personal channel never reached the learning loop.

observed_evidence.link_proof: 2026-10-27 personal publication PUBLISHED urn:li:share:7520742164285280257 with provider_publication_ack_verified is missing in social_posts
observed_evidence.decision_followed: brain/learning/2026-10-06-linkedin-personal-provider-ack-truth-v1.json: provider create acknowledgement is authoritative for side-effect existence

fix: Reusing the six-hour bg-social-metrics-sync, index PUBLISHED or LIVE_PROVEN personal publications that carry the recorded provider acknowledgement into social_posts (tenant canonical, post_id linkedin-personal:<id>) with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Existing reaction readback in linkedin() then measures them.
prevention_rule: Only tenant canonical + channel linkedin_personal + status PUBLISHED with provider_publication_ack_verified=true (or LIVE_PROVEN with live_proven_at) + exact URN + bounded recency is registered. Registration is never a measured result, never a commercial win, never publishes or re-publishes, and never writes views, reach or revenue.
terminal_rule: Protected Required + CodeQL, merged main, deployed Edge function, next real six-hour cron invocation, then social_posts readback of the exact personal URNs and a social_metric_snapshots row per URN. Company analytics and the STORY_FAMILY_DUPLICATE blocks remain separate open items.
